summary: The owned target is verified, 10,440 evidence-gated functions are inventoried, and 842 clean-room functions are byte-identical.

milestones.label: Repository boundary
milestones.detail: ROM exclusions and commit guard installed

milestones.label: First matching unit
milestones.detail: 842 routines, global-state helpers, container templates, and runtime/linker helpers match byte-for-byte

activity.title: IPC, container, and VFP batches matched
activity.detail: Twenty-nine IPC wrappers, eleven duplicate container routines, and eleven VFP/memory helpers raised the genuine report to 842 functions and 18,322 bytes.

activity.title: IPC, table, and mixed-runtime batches matched
activity.detail: Twenty-eight duplicate IPC/table helpers, sixteen ARM/Thumb runtime helpers, and nine multi-identity leaves raised the genuine report to 791 functions and 12,206 bytes.

activity.title: Duplicate and global-state batches matched
activity.detail: Thirty-seven recursive recyclers, ninety-seven global-state/pointer routines, and six runtime helpers raised the genuine report to 738 functions and 9,158 bytes.

activity.title: Global loads and ABI helpers matched
activity.detail: Seventy-nine adjacent global loads, seven scalar literal returns, and eleven ABI helpers raised the genuine report to 598 functions and 5,058 bytes.

activity.title: Runtime and SVC thunks matched
activity.detail: Eighteen public CTR SVC wrappers, four ARM-to-Thumb thunks, and three return stubs raised the genuine report to 501 functions and 3,626 bytes.

activity.title: Opaque address returns matched
activity.detail: Thirty-eight audited address-return functions matched through validated neutral literal identities, raising the genuine report to 476 functions and 3,110 bytes.

activity.title: ARM tail thunks matched
activity.detail: Symbolic branch relocations matched all 27 direct-branch thunks, raising the genuine report to 438 functions and 2,806 bytes without embedding resolved instructions.

activity.title: ARM linker veneers matched
activity.detail: A relocation-based clean-room assembly implementation matched all 285 resolver veneers, raising the genuine report to 411 functions and 2,698 bytes without embedding target addresses.

activity.title: Bitfield wrappers matched
activity.detail: Two additional ARM direct-call wrappers raised the genuine report to 126 matched functions and 1,558 matched bytes.

activity.title: Conditional routines matched
activity.detail: Seventeen ARM conditionals and one Thumb selector raised the genuine report to 124 matched functions and 1,502 matched bytes.

activity.title: Indexed stores matched
activity.detail: Two offset-first ARM store-and-return routines raised the genuine report to 106 matched functions and 1,218 matched bytes.

activity.title: Accessors and call wrappers matched
activity.detail: Twenty-two ARM accessors and twelve direct-call wrappers raised the genuine report to 104 matched functions and 1,186 matched bytes.

activity.title: Probe-verified leaf batch matched
activity.detail: Thirty-four ARM and four Thumb routines raised the genuine report to 70 matched functions and 626 matched bytes.

activity.title: Simple value stubs matched
activity.detail: Fourteen role-separated constant and argument-transform routines raised the genuine report to 32 matched functions and 182 matched bytes.

activity.title: Immediate-return batch matched
activity.detail: Seventeen additional role-separated ARM implementations raised the genuine report to 18 matched functions and 70 matched bytes.

activity.title: First clean-room match
activity.detail: A role-separated portable C implementation of func_00100074 matches all 2 target bytes under objdiff.

activity.title: Function inventory established
activity.detail: Validated 10,440 evidence-gated ARM/Thumb bodies and generated a genuine objdiff baseline without committing target bytes.

activity.title: Target verified
activity.detail: Identified the Rev 2 CARD2 image, extracted the decompressed executable privately, and began the function inventory.

activity.title: ByteMatch pipeline staged
activity.detail: Pinned objdiff-cli and added a main-branch artifact workflow that refuses to publish synthetic progress.

activity.title: Infrastructure checkpoint
activity.detail: Created the clean-room policy, repository safety gate, and ByteMatch integration plan.
